--- create_sequence_params.sql
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS MySequence BIT_REVERSED_POSITIVE SKIP RANGE 1, 1000 START COUNTER WITH 50
--- AST
&ast.CreateSequence{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 30,
        NameEnd: 40,
        Name:    "MySequence",
      },
    },
  },
  IfNotExists: true,
  Params:      []ast.SequenceParam{
    &ast.BitReversedPositive{
      BitReversedPositive: 41,
    },
    &ast.SkipRange{
      Skip: 63,
      Min:  &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 74,
        ValueEnd: 75,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "1",
      },
      Max: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 77,
        ValueEnd: 81,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "1000",
      },
    },
    &ast.StartCounterWith{
      Start:   82,
      Counter: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 101,
        ValueEnd: 103,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "50",
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS MySequence BIT_REVERSED_POSITIVE SKIP RANGE 1, 1000 START COUNTER WITH 50
